notes: G3 spec (amount+1 on the cast count). Printed: '... you may cast A creature spell from among cards exiled with this artifact without paying its mana cost.' The Idol's entry exiles Alpine Watchdog and Igneous Cur (both mana value 2). The ability is activated, the may is taken and Igneous Cur is picked (pool word card:2, its handle in pack-card order idol, aw, cur; the may consumes the first word): exactly one spell is cast, the Cur enters, the Watchdog stays in exile.
